senses.gloss: m. (a denomin. of θερμαί, thermae) bath-keeper or attendant. Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ top היו לו מעות … כדרך שהן יפין אצל הת׳ if one has small coins (v. דִּיסְקַנְסְ), … he may use them for the redemption of second tithes, in the same manner as they are good to be used for the bather (v.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 1:4">Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 4</cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:10">Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ</cite> top <he>עד יעקב תּוּרְמַסְרָה וכ׳</he> (Chald. form; ed. Krot. <he>תרמוסר׳</he>) until he came to the stand of Jacob the bather he kept the T’fillin on; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite> <he>עד יעקר תורמוסא</he> (corr. acc.).
